After a root which has an indicatory अनुदात्त vowel (अनुदात्तेत्) or an indicatory ङ् (ङित्), the affixes are those of the आत्मनेपद।

Terms: अनुदात्त-आत्मनेपद

After the verb क्रम् the आत्मनेपद is optionally used, when it is not preceded by any preposition.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb ज्ञा , when not preceded by any उपसर्ग , the terminations are of the आत्मनेपद , when the fruit of the action accrues to the agent.

Terms: आत्मनेपद

After the verb कृ 'to make' preceded by the अनु and पर , परस्मैपद is used, even the fruit of the action goes to the agent and when the sense is that of 'divulging' etc.

Terms: परस्मैपद

In the case of the verb गृ preceded by अनु and प्रति and meaning 'to encourage by repeating', the person who was the agent of the prior action, which is repeated, is called सम्प्रदान।

Terms: कारक-सम्प्रदान

A word imitative of sounds is also called गति when it is not followed by the word इति।

Terms: गति-संज्ञा

The word अनु , when it denotes a sign, is called कर्म-प्रवचनीय।

Terms: कर्मप्रवचनीय-संज्ञा

The word अनु'near to' is optionally compounded with that word, nearness to which is indicated by the particle and the resulting compound is अव्ययीभाव।

Terms: समास-अव्ययीभाव

A द्वन्द compound or words signifying persons belonging to the different Vedic-schools, when the sense is that of repition is singular.

Terms: समास-द्वन्द

The case-affix es (सुप्) and the affixes having an indicatory प (पित्) are अनुदात्त।

Terms: संज्ञा

The affix श is used after the verbs - धारि , पारि , वेदि , उदेजि , चेति , साति and साहि , when used without a preposition.

Terms: श

The affix युच् comes, in the sense of 'the agent having such a habit etc.' after intransitive verbs as are आत्मनेपदि and begin with a consonant and are अनुदात्त i.e. have a gravely accented vowel as as indicatory.

Terms: युच्

The following rules apply to a प्रातिपदिक (Nominal Stem) which is not a subordinate term in a compound.

Terms: विभक्ति-ङीप्

The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'collection thereof' after the words having अनुदात्त on the first syllable.

Terms: अञ्

The affix इनि comes in the sense of 'who studies or who knows' after the word अनुब्राह्मण।

Terms: इनि

The affix अञ् comes in the sense of 'modification or part' after a word having अनुदात्त - grave accent on the first syllable.

Terms: अञ्

The affix छ (ईय) comes in the same sense of 'that whose purpose is this' after The affix words अनुप्रवचन etc.

Terms: छ (ईय)

The affix ख (ईन) comes in the senses of 'so bound', 'eating that' and 'to carry thereto' after the words 1. अनुपद 2. सर्वान्न and 3. आयन।

Terms: ख (ईन)

The affix ख (ईन) comes in the sense of 'who is fit to follow' after the word अनुगु।

Terms: ख (ईन)

The words 1. अनुक 2. अभिक and 3. अभीक are anomalous meaning 'being at liberty to do or being fond of'.

Terms: Anomalous

The word अनुपदिन् formed anomalously by इनि denotes 'who goes after, who searches'.

Terms: Anomalous

The above affixes come when compassion is denoted.

Terms: कन् (क)

The affix ठक् comes after the word अनुगादिन , without changing its sense.

Terms: ठक्

The word अनुगव is irregularly formed by adding the affix अच् and has the sense of 'suited to the length of the cows'.

Terms: अच्

The augment अम् (अ) augment comes optionally after the ऋ of those roots which are exhibited in the धातुपाठ as अनुदात्त , when such roots end in a consonant having a ऋ has penultimate and are followed by an affix beginning with a mute or sibilant and not having an indicatory क।

Terms:

In the यजुर्वेद , when an अनुदात्त अ is followed by a Guttural or a ध, the antecedent ए or ओ retains it s form, as well as this subsequent अ।

Terms: संहितायाम्

A word is, with the exception of one syllable, unaccented.

Terms: word meaning

An unaccented vowel gets also the acute accent, when on account of it preceding acute is elided.

Terms: accent

Also when the unaccented endings of the three persons in the singular follow, the first syllable of the reduplicate has the acute.

Terms: accent-तिङ्

The penultimate vowel of a अङ्ग (stem) ending in a nasal is lengthened before the affix क्वि and before an affix having an indicatory क् or ङ् which begins with a consonant other than a semi-vowel or a nasal.

Terms: Lengthening

The final nasal of those roots which in the धातुपाठ have an accented root-vowel, as well as of वन , तन etc. (तनादिगणः -8th Conjugation) is elided before an affix beginning with a consonant (except a semi-vowel or nasal) when these have an indicatory क् or ङ्।

Terms: अभीय Rules

Before a तद्धित affix having an indicatory ञ् , ण् or क् , the वृद्धि is substituted for the first vowel of both members of the compounds अनुशतिका etc.

Terms: वृद्धि

That which is called अम्रेडित (repeated) is gravely accented.

Terms: Doubling of Words
Up to (सामान्यवचनं) विभाषितं विशेषवचने (बहुवचनम्)

, inclusive, should always be supplied the phrase 'the whole is unaccented, if it does not stand at the beginning of the foot of a verse'.

Terms: अनुदात्त

The irregular participles 1. फुल्ल 2. क्षीब 3. कृश and 4. उल्लाघ are formed then only, when no preposition precedes them.

Terms: निष्ठा changes

The end vowel at the end of a question or of a praise is प्लुत, but unaccented.

Terms: प्लुत

After what precedes रु , if we omit to substitute the nasal, then अनुस्वार shall be the augment.

Terms: Nasal रु

ष् is optionally the substitute of the स् of स्यन्द् after the उपसर्ग (Prepositions) अनु , वि , परि , अभि and वि when the subject is not a living being.

Terms: षत्व change

In the room of अनुस्वारा, when यय् follows, a letter homogenous with the latter is substituted.
